blogs.title: From Text Prompts to Photorealistic Images: A Beginner’s Guide to Diffusion Models
blogs.description: An easy‑to‑read introduction that explains what text‑to‑image diffusion models are, how they generate pictures from words, and why controlling them is still a tricky problem. It uses everyday analogies (like painting with AI brushes) and sets the stage for the innovations introduced in the following posts.

blogs.title: The Magic of Orthogonal Finetuning: Turning Small Tweaks into Big Improvements
blogs.description: A deep dive into Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT), the new technique that updates model weights via rotation‑like transformations. The post breaks down the core idea—preserving angles between neurons—using visual metaphors such as rotating a constellation without changing its shape, and explains why this matters for keeping a model’s original knowledge intact.

blogs.title: Keeping Your Favorite Subject Recognizable: How OFT Enhances Subject‑Driven Generation
blogs.description: Explains how OFT can be applied to “subject‑driven” tasks like DreamBooth, where users want an AI model to reproduce a specific person or object from just a few photos. The article highlights real‑world examples, shows side‑by‑side comparisons, and discusses why OFT preserves identity better than older methods.

blogs.title: Fine‑Grained Control Without Extra Overhead: OFT Meets Controllable Generation
blogs.description: Shows how Orthogonal Finetuning powers controllable generation—adding edges, segmentation maps, or facial landmarks—to steer AI‑created images precisely. The post contrasts OFT with heavyweight approaches like ControlNet, emphasizing its speed, lower parameter count, and zero inference penalty.

blogs.title: Why Angles Matter More Than Lengths: Understanding Hyperspherical Energy in Neural Networks
blogs.description: Breaks down the concept of hyperspherical energy—a measure of how neuron directions spread out on a sphere—and why keeping this energy steady during finetuning helps preserve semantic meaning. Simple graphics illustrate cosine similarity, energy preservation, and how orthogonal transforms keep the “shape” of knowledge unchanged.

blogs.title: Putting OFT Into Practice: A Step‑by‑Step Guide for Researchers and Hobbyists
blogs.description: Provides a practical tutorial on integrating OFT (and its constrained variant COFT) into popular diffusion frameworks like Stable Diffusion. Includes code snippets, tips on choosing block‑diagonal orthogonal matrices, recommended hyperparameters, and troubleshooting advice for stable training.
